# CANDIDATE: VOL_COMPRESSION_VWAP_RIBBON_BREAK

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a narrow-range (NR4) volatility contraction, price tends to break with momentum when aligned with VWAP slope and a bullish/bearish EMA ribbon, offering a high-probability directional move. This edge exists because NR4 indicates low volatility and compressed liquidity, often preceding an expansion move; alignment with VWAP (institutional fair value) and EMA ribbon (trend structure) increases the probability the break is sustained rather than a falseout.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When today's range is the narrowest of the last 4 bars (NR4) AND price closes above VWAP AND the 5-bar EMA ribbon is bullish (EMA8 > EMA13 > EMA21) AND price exceeds the prior bar's high, enter long at the close; for short, mirror with price below VWAP, bearish ribbon (EMA8 < EMA13 < EMA21), and price below prior bar's low. Exit shape: Initial stop at the low (long) or high (short) of the NR4 bar (chart-stop); target at 2× ATR or trail using a chandelier exit after achieving 1.5R profit. Regime hint: Optimal when VIX < 15 and during mid-morning (09:45‑11:30) when compression often forms; avoid high VIX (>25) or the first 30 minutes after open.
